title: bug: taskless-handoff.test.mjs fails at load since cfd3803 removed its PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT_TRIMMED anchor, so CI's runtime-discovery step is red
description:
Reported by QA (qa-7c627d35, #governors, 2026-10-26T05:09Z) while approving c2cb5cf7. The governor reproduced it.

Repro, from the repo root: `node --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs` exits 1 before any assertion runs, with "missing prompt boundaries: PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT_TRIMMED=$( / ... # 6.". The test slices scripts/moe-agent.sh between `                        PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT_TRIMMED=$(` and `\n                    fi\n                fi\n\n                # 6.` (taskless-handoff.test.mjs:19). Neither launcher contains `PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT_TRIMMED` any more.

Cause: cfd3803, "fix(scripts): preserve daemon task context at launch" (2026-10-24), rewrote the pre-flight context block and removed the anchor. This was found with `git log -S`. The failure predates every current task: it fails the same way on 801495d and on b24ae05.

Impact: .github/workflows/ci.yml, step "Test agent runtime discovery" (around line 242), runs this file. Every PR from moe/work-2026-10-24 to main will be red until it is fixed. It does not affect the running fleet.

Scope: re-anchor the test on the current pre-flight prompt block in both twins, if the test slices the .ps1 too. Keep every taskless-handoff invariant the test asserted; only the anchors are stale. If an invariant genuinely no longer holds after cfd3803, show that from the code rather than dropping the assertion.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs` exits 0 against the current scripts/moe-agent.sh (and moe-agent.ps1 where the test reads it), and so does the full CI step "Test agent runtime discovery" command from .github/workflows/ci.yml.

The test's slice boundaries anchor on code that exists in the current pre-flight block. Every assertion the test made before cfd3803 is still made, or its removal is justified in the commit message with the code that made it obsolete.
The "missing prompt boundaries" guard still fails loudly: with an anchor deliberately altered in a scratch copy, the test exits non-zero naming the missing boundary.
Test-only change: no launcher behaviour changes, and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh still passes.

implementationPlan.description:
Re-anchor the stale slice in scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs. It is a test-only, one-file change; keep LF line endings.

Cause, verified by the architect 2026-10-26: cfd3803 deleted the sh pre-flight trim block (PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT_TRIMMED=$(python ...)) and replaced it with a comment. get_context is now passed through intact. Of the test's four between() anchors, only line 19's `shCurate` is gone. psContext ('    $dynamicContext = ""' to '    # -------- Pre-flight baseline'), psBody and shPrompt still match. The ps1 curation that used to sit inside psContext is now its pass-through code, so it still renders.

Fix:
1. Replace line 19 with: const shPreflightContext = between(sh, '                    if [ -z "$PREFLIGHT_TASK_CHANNEL" ] && [ -n "$PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT" ] && [ -n "$PYTHON_CMD" ]; then', '\n                fi\n\n                # 6.');
   - This is the post-fetch pre-flight region: the chatChannel recovery block plus the pass-through comment, ending before the outer `fi`, so the slice is a balanced if/fi.
   - The anchor is a code line, not prose.
2. Rename the variable at its one use in render() (`script = setup + shPreflightContext + '\n' + shPrompt + ...`).
3. Add a 2-line comment saying why the region is still rendered: it was the curation block until cfd3803, and rendering it keeps any future curation there under the comment-retention assertions.

Do NOT drop the slice. Do NOT change any assertion, any other anchor, or either launcher.

The architect prototyped exactly this in a HEAD archive copy:
- Linux: node --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs gives 44/44 pass.
- Native Windows node.exe (Git Bash, powershell.exe and pwsh.exe engines) gives 106/106 pass.

Loud-guard proof (DoD 3), run in a throwaway copy only: change that anchor line in the COPY's moe-agent.sh (e.g. $PREFLIGHT_TASK_CHANNEL -> $PREFLIGHT_TASK_CHANNEL_X). The test must exit 1 with 'missing prompt boundaries: <the anchor>'. The architect observed exactly this. Delete the copy afterwards.

Error handling: the existing between() assert stays the only failure path for a stale anchor. Keep its message unchanged.

The ONE gate, run fresh in a snapshot of HEAD plus this task's file only. Do not run it in the shared tree: task-7a0b1881 is editing scripts/tests/moe-account-lease.test.mjs, one of the files in this CI step, right now.
1. S=$(mktemp -d /tmp/moe-cd4e-gate.XXXXXX)
2. git -C /mnt/d/projexts/moes archive HEAD scripts docs | tar -x -C "$S"
3. cp /mnt/d/projexts/moes/scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs "$S/scripts/tests/" and cmp it against the worktree.
4. cd "$S" && env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin bash -c 'node --test scripts/tests/agent-runtime.test.mjs scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-session.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-report.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-attribution.test.mjs scripts/tests/resume-progress.test.mjs scripts/tests/moe-account-lease.test.mjs && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh'

This is CI's 'Test agent runtime discovery' step (.github/workflows/ci.yml ~line 242) plus parity. It must exit 0. The architect saw 172 tests, 171 pass, 1 skipped, 0 fail on 2026-10-26; the counts can grow if HEAD moves. This command is the complete_task verification.

Also record native Windows evidence in the summary:
- Copy $S's scripts/ and docs/ into a mktemp dir under /mnt/c/Users/Yaron/AppData/Local/Temp.
- From that cwd, with MOE_*/CLAUDE* stripped, run "/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs. It must exit 0 with 106 pass (mem:pattern-qa-windows-native-vitest-from-wsl for the cwd and env rules).
- From a native Git Bash seat, run it with its own node.

Remove both temp dirs after checking their prefixes. The summary must name exactly one modified path: scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs.
implementationPlan.note: CI step + parity exit 0 (172 tests, 171 pass, 1 skip). Loud guard proven (exit 1, names anchor). Native node.exe 106/106. Native Git Bash seat run not done separately.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review of the one-line diff. Load adversarial-self-review.

Check:
- The new slice is syntactically balanced bash under /bin/bash and Git Bash. It runs harmlessly in every render(), including taskless cases with PREFLIGHT_TASK_ID empty: the chatChannel python prints '' and a missing python falls through to `|| echo ""`.
- Every pre-existing assertion is byte-identical (git diff shows only the anchor line, the rename and the comment).
- The anchor is code, not prose.
- The loud guard was proven.
- No launcher, parity or docs file changed (git diff --stat).

Fix any finding, then rerun step 2 before moe.complete_task.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Chosen: re-anchor the sh slice on the current post-fetch pre-flight region. It anchors on the chatChannel-recovery `if` code line and ends before the outer `fi`. The region stays rendered, so any future curation reintroduced there is still caught by the comment-retention assertions; that preserves the protection the original slice gave.
Rejected:
- Deleting the slice: simpler, but a reintroduced curation step between the fetch and `# 6.` would then go untested.
- Anchoring on the pass-through comment: prose churns more than code.
- Including the `# 5.` fetch block: it needs moe_rpc and plan_progress_mark stubs, making the test more brittle.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- cfd3803 (2026-10-24, 'preserve daemon task context at launch') removed both launchers' get_context field allowlists. sh deleted its python trim (PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT_TRIMMED). ps1's $ctxJson block now passes the payload through, still inside the psContext slice.
- The test's render() executes real launcher slices: bash runs setup + sh slice + shPrompt; ps1 runs setup + psContext + psBody.
- CI step 'Test agent runtime discovery' runs 11 node:test files, including moe-account-lease.test.mjs.
- Measured with the fix: Linux CI step 172 tests, 171 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail. Native Windows taskless-handoff 106/106.
planningNotes.risks:
- The shared checkout has 500+ foreign dirty paths, and task-7a0b1881 is editing moe-account-lease.test.mjs (part of this CI step). Gate in a HEAD snapshot with only this file overlaid.
- Git Bash has no python3; render() sets PYTHON_CMD=python on Windows and the block tolerates a missing interpreter.
- Anchors are whitespace-exact (20 and 16 spaces); copy them exactly.
